你今天的表现，我很不满意（你今天的表现，我很不满意（第22页）“那不是忠义侯吗？”“后面那几个银甲女子是谁？好大的排场！”“你瞎了？那是凤卫！女帝陛下的亲卫！”“凤卫？乖乖，忠义侯也配……”“嘘，小点声，不要命了？”……朱漆大门上的“忠义侯府”四个金字在阳光下熠熠生辉。门楣下方，两个门房正伸长了脖子张望，看见汪海回来，连忙跑下台阶，接过缰绳。“侯爷回来了！”“把这几位凤卫姑娘的马也牵到后院去，好生照料。”汪海翻身下马，将缰绳扔给门房，转头看向青鸢，“青鸢统领，请。”青鸢翻身下马，动作干脆利落。她抬眼扫了一眼侯府的大门和围墙，眉头微微皱起，似乎在评估这里的防御能力。“侯爷这府邸，墙矮门窄，若是强敌来袭，怕是连半刻钟都守不住。”汪海也不恼，笑道：“所以才请青鸢统领来坐镇嘛。”青鸢冷冷地瞥了他一眼，没有再说什么，带着四名凤卫大步走进了侯府。汪海跟在后面，穿过垂花门，绕过影壁，径直往后院的卧室走去。推开楼门。屋内还燃着半截红烛，烛泪在铜台上凝成一团暗红。罗帐半掩，锦被凌乱。萧璃月已经醒了。她缩在床角，锦被裹到下巴，只露出一张苍白的小脸。那双杏眼红肿，望着推门而入的汪海，身子后缩了缩。汪海站在门口，逆光而立，居高临下地打量着萧璃月。“醒了？”萧璃月咬着唇，没有说话，只是将锦被裹得更紧。汪海也不在意，自顾自走到桌前，倒了杯隔夜的凉茶，一饮而尽。他转过身，背靠桌沿，目光落在萧璃月身上。“昨天你的表现，本侯很满意。”萧璃月身子微颤，低垂眼帘。“但你今天的表现……”汪海摇了摇头，他将茶杯搁在桌上，转身就往外走。“还是考虑一下，怎么给你的哥哥收尸吧。”“侯爷不要！”萧璃月猛地从床上扑下来，锦被滑落，露出大片雪白的肌肤。萧璃月顾不得整理衣衫，膝行几步，扑到汪海脚边，死死抱住他的小腿。“侯爷……求求您……不要伤害兄长……求您……”汪海低头看着她，面无表情。“你叫我什么？”萧璃月一怔，随即想起昨夜这个男人逼她喊的那个称呼。“……主人。”汪海蹲下身，伸手捏住她的下巴，迫她抬起头来与自己对视。那双杏眼里蓄满了泪水，却倔强地没有落下。“不错，看来你没有忘记昨日的教导。”萧璃月的身体在颤抖，却不敢躲开他的手。“记住，从今往后，你只有一个身份。”“本侯的奴仆。”萧璃月闭上眼睛，泪水从眼缝中滑落出来。“……是，主人。”汪海松开手，任由她跌坐回地上。……青鸢负手站在楼外，银甲在晨光下泛着冷冽的光泽。她耳力极好，即便隔着门窗，也能听到屋内传来的声音。那声音断断续续，压抑而婉转。青鸢的眉头越皱越紧，指节捏得咔咔作响。“统领……”身后一名凤卫欲言又止。“闭嘴。”青鸢冷冷吐出两个字，目光望向远处的天际线。她是凤卫副统领，修为已至命丹境九重，在军中摸爬滚打十年，什么场面没见过？但她还是觉得恶心。生死攸关之际，这个所谓的忠义侯不思如何御敌，反倒关起门来白日宣淫，与那萧家女纠缠不休。烂泥扶不上墙。真不知陛下为何独宠此人！……

I'm very dissatisfied with your performance today (I'm very dissatisfied with your performance today (page 22) "Isn't that Marquis Zhongyi?" "Who are those women in silver armor at the back? What a grand display!" "Are you blind? That's Feng Wei! Her Majesty the Empress's personal guard!" "Feng Wei? Be good, Marquis Zhongyi is also worthy..." "Hush, lower your voice, don't risk your life?"... The four gold characters of "Zhongyi Hou Mansion" on the red lacquer door are shining in the sun. Shining. Under the door lintel, two porters stretched their necks and looked around. When they saw Wang Hai coming back, they quickly ran down the steps and took the reins. "The Marquis is back!" "Take the horses of these Fengwei girls to the backyard. Take care of me." Wang Hai got off his horse, threw the reins to the porter, and turned to look at Qing Yuan, "Commander Qing Yuan, please." Qing Yuan got off her horse and moved quickly. She glanced up at the gate and wall of the Hou Mansion. , frowning slightly, as if assessing the defense capabilities here, "The Marquis's mansion has short walls and narrow doors. If a strong enemy attacks, I'm afraid I won't be able to defend it for even half a quarter of an hour." Wang Hai was not annoyed and said with a smile: "That's why I invited you. Commander Qingyuan is here to take charge." Qingyuan glanced at him coldly, without saying anything, and strode into the Hou Mansion with four Phoenix Guards. Wang Hai followed, passed through the hanging flower gate, walked around the screen wall, and went straight to the backyard. Go to the bedroom. Open the door. There is still half a red candle burning on the copper table. The curtain is half covered, and the brocade quilt is messy. She had a pale face with red and swollen almond-shaped eyes, and she shrank back as she pushed the door open. Wang Hai stood against the light and looked at Xiao Liyue condescendingly. "Are you awake?" He pursed his lips and didn't say anything, but wrapped the brocade quilt tighter. Wang Hai walked to the table, poured a cup of overnight herbal tea, and drank it in one gulp. He turned around and leaned against the edge of the table, his eyes falling on Xiao Liyue. "I was very satisfied with your performance yesterday." Xiao Liyue trembled slightly and lowered her eyes. "But your performance today..." Wang Hai shook his head, put the tea cup on the table, and turned around and walked out. Think about how to collect your brother's body." "Master Hou, don't!" Xiao Liyue jumped off the bed, and the brocade quilt slipped off, revealing a large piece of snow-white skin. Xiao Liyue didn't bother to adjust her clothes, took a few steps to Wang Hai's feet, and hugged his calf. "Master Hou... please... don't hurt my brother... please..." Wang Hai looked down at her, expressionless. "What did you call me?" , and then remembered the title that the man forced her to call last night. "...Master." Wang Hai knelt down and held her chin, forcing her to raise her head to look at him. Her almond eyes were filled with tears, but she stubbornly did not fall. "Yes, it seems that you have not forgotten yesterday's teaching." Xiao Liyue's body was shaking, but she did not dare to avoid his hand. "Remember, from now on, you have only one identity." Servant." Xiao Liyue closed her eyes, tears falling from her eyes. "...Yes, Master." Wang Hai let go of his hand and let her fall back to the ground. ... Qingyuan stood outside the building with her hands folded, her silver armor glowing in the morning light. It had a cold sheen. Her ears were very good, and she could still hear the sound coming from inside the room. The sound was intermittent, suppressed and gentle. Qingyuan's brows became tighter and her knuckles cracked.Leader..." A Feng guard behind him stopped talking. "Shut up. "Qingyuan uttered two words coldly and looked at the distant skyline. She is the deputy commander of Fengwei. Her cultivation has reached the ninth level of Mingdan realm. She has been fighting in the army for ten years. What scene has she not seen? But she still feels sick. When life and death are at stake, this so-called loyal prince does not think about how to defend against the enemy. Instead, he closes the door and engages in prostitution during the day, entangled with the Xiao family daughter. Mud can't support the wall. I really don't know why Your Majesty favors this person alone! ...
